method: Interval counters; runs dying within a stage contribute at death. Enemy mean is at measured endpoint, not a continuous stage mean. Survival denominator is initial cohort; post-death stages have no measurements. First-hit TTK is distinct from spawn travel time. Tiny 3-seed cohorts and deterministic controllers are not human win rates. End observations around299.8s due draft iterations are classified in300s tolerance0.3s; actual seconds retained.
